verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page states you can 'Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request', then refine, approve and merge in the app. Agent Tasks on mobile let users start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks, and Copilot docs describe the issue → agent → pull request → review → merge flow. missing for 10: in-depth mobile-specific documentation of the assign-to-agent flow (beyond marketing copy), independent or hands-on corroboration of it working on mobile.
